QUOTE: unless a repo declares an `index_scope:` in its `.clew.yaml`, clew indexes the whole repository.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a declared `index_scope` is used. It also states that an absent, unparseable or unusable declaration falls back to whole-repo indexing ("A missing or unparseable file is treated as absent", "REJECTED ─► whole-repo", "derive_scope then falls back to whole-repo").
